$doc: ULARA Omega 2-A — the ONE source of truth for the product name and its identity primitives. The rename itself is gated behind Gate A (owner approval); until that gate opens NOTHING on the product surface consumes this file — the staged kit (shared/brand/ulara/ + scripts/brand/ulara-kit.mjs) is its only consumer, so the future rename stays a one-file change. Regen: node scripts/brand/ulara-kit.mjs · verify: node --test scripts/brand/ulara-kit.test.mjs. Name rules (test-enforced): name_ar is the logo form WITH damma — the damma-less spelling is forbidden anywhere in the kit; name_en is the running-text form — all-caps ULARA is allowed ONLY inside logo lockups; colours are the unchanged palette, pinned to shared/design-tokens.json color.brand.

colors.$doc: The only three brand colours, carried over verbatim from shared/design-tokens.json color.brand (paper #F6F6EE / ink #282828 / orange #FA3600). The rename changes the name, never the palette — the generator cross-checks this trio against design-tokens.json on every run.
